Info state medium intensity. Use for text and icon on light surfaces (WCAG AA).
Info state low intensity (~18% alpha). Use for subdued info borders and background fills.
Info state frosted intensity (~55% alpha). Use as background behind backdrop-filter: blur(var(--io-blur-frosted)) for glassmorphism info panels.
Info state frosted-soft intensity (~35% alpha). :hover companion for --io-color-info-frosted.
Font weight 200 (extra-light). Deprecated: the design system uses only regular/semibold/bold. Scheduled for removal; migrate to --io-font-weight-regular (400).
Font weight 300 (light). Deprecated: the design system uses only regular/semibold/bold. Scheduled for removal; migrate to --io-font-weight-regular (400).
Font weight 400 (regular). One of the three canonical weights (regular/semibold/bold) used by the design system.
Font weight 700 (bold). One of the three canonical weights (regular/semibold/bold) used by the design system.
Font weight 800 (extra-bold). Deprecated: the design system uses only regular/semibold/bold. Scheduled for removal; migrate to --io-font-weight-bold (700).
Duration of one indeterminate animation cycle. Defaults to 1s. Consumers can increase this for WCAG 2.2.2 compliance.
Global z-index for the tooltip layer.
Canonical interactive control height scale — xs (24px). Used for chips, compact UI elements. Resolves to 1.5rem.
Canonical interactive control height scale — sm (32px). Used for small controls, stepper circles. Resolves to 2rem.
Canonical interactive control height scale — md (40px). Default input and button height. Resolves to 2.5rem.
Canonical interactive control height scale — lg (48px). Large controls, pin-code slots. Resolves to 3rem.
Canonical interactive control height scale — xl (64px). XL button, hero controls. Resolves to 4rem.
Animation duration for the .io-skeleton global utility shimmer. Consumer override point defined in app.css. Defaults to 1.6s.
Start/end color of the .io-skeleton shimmer gradient. Consumer override point defined in app.css. Defaults to --io-color-grey-2.
Peak (lighter) color of the .io-skeleton shimmer gradient. Consumer override point defined in app.css. Defaults to --io-color-grey-5.
Color of the underline and text when the link is in the active (current nav item) state. Defaults to var(--io-color-primary).
Color of the text and underline when io-link-pure is in the active (current nav item) state. Defaults to var(--io-color-primary).
Color applied to the step circle border, icon, and label when status='error'. Defaults to --io-text-error. Override to theme error steps independently.
Text color for content slotted into the description slot (secondary text below the step label). Defaults to --io-text-secondary.
Icon color of the calendar trigger button. Defaults to --io-text-secondary.
Background color of the calendar trigger button on hover. Defaults to --io-color-neutral-100.
Minimum height of the empty-state region rendered when io-table has no body rows. Defaults to 120px. Override to control the visual size of the empty state.
Background colour of the loading overlay that covers the table body when the loading prop is true. Defaults to a semi-transparent page background. Override to match your table's surface colour.
Background colour of a selected body row in io-table-body-row. Defaults to --io-color-primary-muted. Override to change the selection highlight colour.
Top offset used when sticky=true to keep the scroll indicator buttons visible during long scrolls. Defaults to 0. Override when the scroller is used inside a layout with a sticky header.

Duration (and optional easing) of the fill-width transition when the progress value changes. Defaults to var(--io-motion-base) (300ms ease). Set to 0s to disable the transition without using the animated prop.
